summary: SuperX AI Technology Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting financial results for H1 FY2026 and disclosed the divestiture of its legacy Hong Kong interior design business. On May 7, 2026, the company fully disposed of OPS Interior Design Consultant Limited. No financial terms, premium, or advisor were disclosed. The filing also describes a strategic pivot to full-stack AI infrastructure solutions and the discontinuation of interior fit-out services. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as an equivalent of a material event report. Watch for closing of the divestiture and potential use of proceeds for AI business growth.
